def prune(nd, na):
    """Filter domains using clues. Returns False on contradiction."""
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for keys, f in C:
            un = [k for k in keys if k not in na]
            if not un:
                if not f(*[na[k] for k in keys]):
                    return False
                continue
            if len(un) == 1:
                u = un[0]
                ui = keys.index(u)
                newset = set()
                for q in nd[u]:
                    vals = [na[k] if k in na else None for k in keys]
                    vals[ui] = q
                    if f(*vals):
                        newset.add(q)
                if not newset:
                    return False
                if newset != nd[u]:
                    nd[u] = newset
                    changed = True
    return True
